rationale: cycle.md already carries the off-hours duplicate-guard (line 51, AutoCure 2026-05-14 TNB c47) — exactly the safeguard needed for unchanged-price prepost scans.

AC-5: Next prepost cron fire (next */30 tick) returns DONE (not BLOCKED) — verify in cowork-team next dispatch log.
